[![Downloads][downloads-shield]][downloads-url] [![Release][release-shield]][releases-url] [![Forks][forks-shield]][forks-url] [![Stargazers][stars-shield]][stars-url] [![Issues][issues-shield]][issues-url] [![MIT License][license-shield]][license-url]

Frpc-Desktop

🎉 Cross-platform desktop client for FRP, visual configuration, easily achieve intranet penetration!
All frp versions / Multiple instances / Cloudflare Tunnel / Light & dark theme / Free and open source

🎊 10,000+ Downloads Milestone! Thank you for your support!

📖 Docs   中文

> 💡 If you prefer a **web UI**, try [Podux](https://github.com/luckjiawei/podux) — > the browser-based frpc manager from the same author. ## Download Get the latest installer from [Releases](https://github.com/luckjiawei/frpc-desktop/releases/latest): | Platform | Packages | | --- | --- | | Windows | `.msi` and `.exe` installers | | macOS | `.dmg` (Apple Silicon and Intel) | | Linux | `.AppImage`, `.deb`, `.rpm` | > 2.0 is a full rebuild on Tauri 2 — installers are much smaller than the 1.x Electron builds. ## What's New in 2.0 - **Rebuilt on Tauri 2** — smaller downloads and lower memory usage than the Electron version. - **Multiple instances** — run several frpc tunnels to different frps servers at the same time. - **Cloudflare Tunnel** — manage cloudflared instances next to your frpc instances. - **New dashboard** — a read-only overview of running instances, proxies, connection errors, and bulk start/stop. - **Refreshed UI** — light, dark, and system themes, collapsible sidebar, and copyable addresses. - **Drawer configuration** — edit each instance's config and view its logs in a side drawer without leaving the page. - **SQLite storage** — automatic, backup-safe import of existing 1.x data. ## TODO - [x] Auto-start on boot - [x] Support multiple users with user & meta_token - [x] Portable version - [x] Add UDP proxy type - [x] Support quick sharing of frps - [x] Add quick local port selection - [x] Support STCP proxy type - [x] Download frp through mirror sites - [x] Support import/export of all configurations - [x] One-click clear all configurations - [x] Support importing and recognizing frpc.toml - [x] TCP and UDP protocols support batch ports - [x] Support multiple languages - [x] Fast proxy search with card/list pagination - [x] Light, dark, and system appearance - [x] Run multiple frpc instances (different frps servers) at the same time - [x] Cloudflare Tunnel (cloudflared) instances alongside frpc ## Development Requirements: Node.js 22.12+, npm, and a stable Rust toolchain ([Tauri prerequisites](https://v2.tauri.app/start/prerequisites/)). ```sh npm ci npm run tauri:dev # run the desktop app in development mode npm run tauri:build # build installers for the current platform ``` ## Resource usage The sidebar reports the combined CPU and resident memory of Frpc-Desktop and its descendant processes, including frpc and cloudflared instances started by the app. Values refresh every three seconds. CPU usage is normalized to total machine capacity (0–100%); memory is the sum of process resident memory, so shared pages may be counted more than once. On macOS, WebKit helper processes hosted by system services are outside this process tree and are not included. ## Common Issues ### Upgrading from 1.x Version 2.0 is rebuilt on Tauri and upgrades the 1.x Electron app in place. Your server settings, proxies, desktop settings, and downloaded frpc versions are kept automatically; data still stored in the older NeDB format (1.2.6 and earlier) is imported on first launch and the original files are kept as `*.bak`. Multi-instance support migrates your existing single server into a default instance (`id = "1"`) that cannot be deleted. All existing proxies belong to it, so nothing changes unless you create additional instances. ### Using Cloudflare Tunnel 1. In the Cloudflare dashboard, go to Zero Trust → Networks → Tunnels, create a tunnel with the "cloudflared" connector, and add its public hostnames there. 2. In Frpc-Desktop, open Instances → New Instance → Cloudflare Tunnel, then paste the token (or the whole install command shown in the dashboard) into the instance config. 3. Download cloudflared on the Download page (switch to "Cloudflare Tunnel"), or pick a locally installed binary. If no version is selected, a cloudflared found in `PATH` is used. The app runs cloudflared with its own minimal config, so your `~/.cloudflared/config.yml` is never used by these instances. ### Mac shows app is damaged Run command: `sudo xattr -cr Frpc-Desktop.app` ## Milestones - 2026-11-13: Released v2.0.1 Redesigned log viewer with level filtering, search and copy, refreshed toast styling and process resource fixes - 2026-11-11: Released v2.0.0 Rebuilt on Tauri 2, multiple instances, Cloudflare Tunnel, dashboard and dark mode - 2026-09-04: Released v1.2.7 SQLite storage, pagination and performance improvements - 2026-05-21: Released v1.2.6 Added download proxy selection - 2026-03-26: Released v1.2.5 Fixed known bugs - 2025-09-10: Released v1.2.3 Fixed known bugs, Supports proxy protocol, Optimize performance - 2025-04-22: Released v1.2.2 Fixed known bugs, Supports HTTP Locations - 2025-03-25: Released v1.2.1 Fixed known bugs, Supports english - 2025-03-06: Released v1.2.0 Underlying reconstruction, improved stability - 2025-01-09: Released v1.1.6 - 2024-12-04: Released v1.1.5 Optimized experience, support modifying webport, solved GitHub rate limit issues, log optimization - 2024-11-08: Released v1.1.4 Fixed known bugs - 2024-10-14: Released v1.1.3 Support XTCP protocol, optimized experience - 2024-09-25: Released v1.1.2 Support HTTP basic auth, subdomains - 2024-09-07: Released v1.1.0 Support batch ports, single proxy switch control - 2024-08-24: Released v1.0.9 Support mirror downloads, config import/export - 2024-08-17: Released v1.0.8 Support STCP proxy - 2024-08-11: Released v1.0.7 - 2024-08-09: Released v1.0.6 - 2024-08-06: Released v1.0.5 - 2024-08-06: Released v1.0.4 Adapted to support multi-user plugin - 2024-07-17: Released v1.0.3 Fixed known bugs, added auto-start, added frp version deletion - 2024-01-29: Released v1.0.2 Added Linux client and proxy mode - 2023-12-01: Released v1.0.1 - 2023-11-28: Released v1.0 ## Community No advertisements allowed!!! Follow official account to join group** ## Screenshot ![launch](https://github.com/luckjiawei/frpc-desktop/blob/main/screenshots/en/launch.png?raw=true) ![proxys manager](https://github.com/luckjiawei/frpc-desktop/blob/main/screenshots/en/proxy.png?raw=true) ![frp download](https://github.com/luckjiawei/frpc-desktop/blob/main/screenshots/en/download.png?raw=true) ![config](https://github.com/luckjiawei/frpc-desktop/blob/main/screenshots/en/config.png?raw=true) ![logger](https://github.com/luckjiawei/frpc-desktop/blob/main/screenshots/en/logger.png?raw=true) ![about](https://github.com/luckjiawei/frpc-desktop/blob/main/screenshots/en/about.png?raw=true) ## Donate 👉👉👉[Click to donate](https://jwinks.com/donate/)👈👈👈 ## Contributors ## License [MIT](LICENSE) ## Star History [![Star History Chart](https://api.star-history.com/svg?repos=luckjiawei/frpc-desktop&type=Date)](https://www.star-history.com/#luckjiawei/frpc-desktop&Date) [downloads-shield]: https://img.shields.io/github/downloads/luckjiawei/frpc-desktop/total.svg?style=for-the-badge [downloads-url]: https://github.com/luckjiawei/frpc-desktop/releases [release-shield]: https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/luckjiawei/frpc-desktop.svg?style=for-the-badge [releases-url]: https://github.com/luckjiawei/frpc-desktop/releases [forks-shield]: https://img.shields.io/github/forks/luckjiawei/frpc-desktop.svg?style=for-the-badge [forks-url]: https://github.com/luckjiawei/frpc-desktop/network/members [stars-shield]: https://img.shields.io/github/stars/luckjiawei/frpc-desktop.svg?style=for-the-badge [stars-url]: https://github.com/luckjiawei/frpc-desktop/stargazers [issues-shield]: https://img.shields.io/github/issues/luckjiawei/frpc-desktop.svg?style=for-the-badge [issues-url]: https://github.com/luckjiawei/frpc-desktop/issues [license-shield]: https://img.shields.io/github/license/luckjiawei/frpc-desktop.svg?style=for-the-badge [license-url]: https://github.com/luckjiawei/frpc-desktop/blob/master/LICENSE

Frpc-Desktop

🎉 FRP跨平台桌面客户端，可视化配置，轻松实现内网穿透！
支持所有frp版本 / 多实例并发 / Cloudflare Tunnel / 浅色与深色主题 / 免费开源

🎊 下载量突破 10,000！感谢大家的支持！

📖 文档   常见问题   English

> 💡 如果你更喜欢 **Web 界面**，试试 [Podux](https://github.com/luckjiawei/podux) — > 基于浏览器的 frpc 可视化管理工具。 ## 下载 前往 [Releases](https://github.com/luckjiawei/frpc-desktop/releases/latest) 下载最新安装包： | 平台 | 安装包 | | --- | --- | | Windows | `.msi` 与 `.exe` 安装包 | | macOS | `.dmg`（支持 Apple Silicon 与 Intel） | | Linux | `.AppImage`、`.deb`、`.rpm` | > 2.0 基于 Tauri 2 全面重构，安装包体积比 1.x 的 Electron 版本小很多。 ## 2.0 新特性 - **基于 Tauri 2 重构**：安装包更小，内存占用更低。 - **多实例**：可同时运行多个 frpc 实例，连接不同的 frps 服务端。 - **Cloudflare Tunnel**：与 frpc 实例一起管理 cloudflared 实例。 - **全新仪表盘**：只读展示运行中实例、代理数量、连接异常，并支持一键全部启动/停止。 - **界面焕新**：浅色、深色和跟随系统主题，侧边栏可收起，地址可一键复制。 - **抽屉式配置**：在实例页以右侧抽屉编辑配置、查看日志，无需跳转页面。 - **SQLite 存储**：自动安全导入 1.x 的现有数据。 ## TODO - [x] 开机自启动 - [x] 适配多用户 user & meta_token - [x] 便携版 - [x] 增加udp代理类型 - [x] 支持快速分享frps - [x] 增加快速选择本地端口 - [x] 支持stcp代理类型 - [x] 通过镜像站下载frp - [x] 支持所有配置的导入导出 - [x] 一键清空所有配置 - [x] 支持导入识别frpc.toml - [x] tcp、udp协议支持批量端口 - [x] support multiple languages - [x] 支持代理快速搜索及卡片/列表分页 - [x] 支持浅色、深色和跟随系统外观 - [x] 支持同时运行多个 frpc 实例（连接不同的 frps） - [x] 支持 Cloudflare Tunnel（cloudflared）实例，可与 frpc 同时运行 ## 开发 环境要求：Node.js 22.12+、npm 和稳定版 Rust 工具链（参见 [Tauri 环境准备](https://v2.tauri.app/zh-cn/start/prerequisites/)）。 ```sh npm ci npm run tauri:dev # 以开发模式运行桌面应用 npm run tauri:build # 为当前平台构建安装包 ``` ## 资源占用 侧栏显示 Frpc-Desktop 及其后代进程的 CPU 和驻留内存合计，包括由应用启动的 frpc、cloudflared 实例，每 3 秒刷新一次。CPU 按整机总算力归一化（0–100%）；内存为各进程驻留内存之和，共享内存页可能重复计入。macOS 中由系统服务托管的 WebKit 辅助进程不属于此进程树，暂不计入。 ## 常见问题 ### 从 1.x 升级 2.0 版本基于 Tauri 重构，可直接覆盖升级 1.x 的 Electron 版本。服务器配置、代理、系统设置和已下载的 frpc 版本会自动保留；仍为旧 NeDB 格式的数据（1.2.6 及更早版本）会在首次启动时导入，原文件以 `*.bak` 保留。 启用多实例后，原有的单个服务端会迁移为默认实例（`id = "1"`），且不可删除。现有代理都归属于该实例，不新建实例时使用方式与之前完全一致。 ### 使用 Cloudflare Tunnel 1. 在 Cloudflare 控制台进入 Zero Trust → 网络 → 隧道，创建连接器为 cloudflared 的隧道，并在控制台中添加公共主机名。 2. 在 Frpc-Desktop 中打开“实例 → 新建实例 → Cloudflare Tunnel”，在实例配置中粘贴令牌（也可以直接粘贴控制台给出的完整安装命令）。 3. 在“下载”页切换到 Cloudflare Tunnel 下载 cloudflared，或选择本机已安装的文件；未选择版本时会使用 `PATH` 中的 cloudflared。 应用会为 cloudflared 生成独立的最小配置，这些实例不会读取你的 `~/.cloudflared/config.yml`。 ##
